title: Burnt Ships Drops New Single "Robbery" - A Contemporary Take on Courtship
htmlContent:
Burnt Ships, the Philly-North Carolina-American Samoa duo, is making waves in the music industry with their fresh take on contemporary R&B. Their latest single, "Robbery," features Samoan singer-songwriter Gary King on vocals and Nonseq on beat duties, is a mid-tempo-club-banger-that's sure to get people dancing.

The song tells the story of a cat-and-mouse courtship, with King's smooth falsetto gliding over a contemporary, infectious R&B beat. The catchy chorus and booming trap bass make "Robbery" a perfect fit for any pop/R&B playlist. Burnt Ships has been working on several projects during the pandemic, collaborating with artists such as Mickey Shiloh and Trinket.

With their music featured on popular shows like MTV, E!, Bravo, and Netflix, Burnt Ships is a rising star in the music industry. If you're looking for energetic, sexy, and romantic music with a Samoan twist, "Robbery" is the perfect song to add to your playlist.
